decision_rationale: Stetho-MSAE is selected as the production champion over Dense Autoencoder and Isolation Forest based on empirical evidence across multiple operational axes: (1) Superior/Competitive Discrimination: Perfect ROC-AUC (1.0000) on id_00 and id_02, 0.9778 on id_06, and 0.8000 on id_04, outperforming Dense Autoencoder on id_00 and id_04. (2) Extreme Parameter Efficiency: ~560k parameters (74% reduction vs. Dense Autoencoder's 2.15M parameters). (3) Compact Storage Footprint: ~4.4 MB total directory artifact (vs. 17.0 MB for Dense Autoencoder: ~74% reduction). (4) Ultra-Fast Cold Loading: 19.59 ms cold model load time (4x faster than Dense Autoencoder's 73.86 ms and IF's 74.4 ms). (5) Real-Time Inference: 58.60 ms median CPU latency, well within the sub-100ms real-time inspection budget. (6) Empirical Robustness: Mathematically verified stability under Gaussian noise, volume scaling, clipping, and packet drops with monotonic degradation and zero numerical divergence (no NaN/Inf).
